body: API_SPECIFICATION.md ("LeBoncoin session input" and "Save settings") says an empty or whitespace-only `leboncoinSession.value` leaves the session unchanged, and the technical spec maps a blank value to untouched. `sessionChangeFor` hands the raw value to `leboncoin.ParseSessionInput`, but that function checks `len(raw) > 8192` before it trims. So `{"leboncoinSession":{"value":"<9000 spaces>","revision":r}}`, which fits within the 32 768-byte body limit, returns `400 INVALID_SESSION` ("The pasted text is too long") instead of `200` with the session untouched. The frontend trims before it sends, so the impact is low, but the server breaks its own contract. Suggested fix: in `sessionChangeFor`, return `nil, nil` when `strings.TrimSpace(input.Value) == ""` before calling `ParseSessionInput`, the same way `tokenChangeFor` trims first. Add a case with a long whitespace-only value to TC-005/TC-007.
